GenAiFunction.description: Renders a generic, caller-driven list of proposed next steps. THE AGENT SUPPLIES THE STEPS: pass a JSON `spec` describing optional title/subtitle/badges, an optional summary callout, and a `steps` array (each step has a title plus optional detail, rationale, iconName, iconColor, priorityLabel, priorityVariant, meta line and a per-step link). The action normalizes the steps (auto-numbering their order) into the typed payload the card renders. Call with no spec to show a portable demo plan.
